simple.summary: עֵין גַּנִּים (ʻÊyn Gannîym) means En-Gannim , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 15 34.

definitions.full: H5873. En Gannim גַּנִּים עֵין proper name, of a location 1. in the Shephelah of Judah Josh 15:34 , perhaps Umm-³îna , approximately 1mile South of West from Bethshemesh ClGann Buhl Geogr.194 f. 2 in Issachar Josh 19:21 (A Ηνγαννιμ ), Levitical city 21:29 ( πηγὴν γραμμάτων ); hence by text error עָנֵם 1Chr 6:58 ; Gennin , near Southeast end of plain of Jezreel, approximately 15 miles north-northeast from Samaria, Buhl Geogr.202 .
